description: Hand-authored fixture corpus for the semantic-entropy backend parity smoke (RF-06, scripts/se_backend_parity_smoke.py). Each item holds 3-5 short English verdict strings in one of three design classes: 'paraphrase_disjoint' (same meaning, no shared content tokens after stopword filtering - the case where the token-fingerprint and NLI backends are expected to diverge), 'contradiction_lexical' (shared content tokens, opposite meaning - including word-order reversals with identical token sets, where the fingerprint backend is expected to false-merge), and 'identical' (identical or near-identical responses, where both backends are expected to agree on a single cluster). All sentences are original. Class labels describe design intent, not measured backend behavior; the measured comparison lives only in the CI-produced smoke artifact.

classes.contradiction_lexical: opposite meaning, shared content tokens (some with identical token sets)
